scope_note: Angell identifies this as the first of three forms of the functional problem. The claim supports a bounded contrastive influence, not wholesale derivation, succession, or displacement.
statement: Angell said one conception of functional psychology derived most immediately from contrast with structural psychology.
statement_zh: Angell 表示，功能心理學的一種構想最直接地源自它與結構心理學的對比。
